## About
Advanced German Auto is a family operated business that focuses on the maintenance and upkeep of German cars, especially BMW and Mercedes. We treat every car that comes through our doors as if it were one of our own.
We value your time and our integrity, so we never recommend a service we don't feel is necessary. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating across 76 Google reviews.

## Services
- Coding and programming: Coding and programming for newer vehicles.
- Balancing, rotating and wheel repair: Wheel balancing, rotation and wheel repair done in the shop.
- AC service: Keep your car cool through a Jersey summer.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in German cars and keep BMW and Mercedes models in top running condition.

Q: What parts do you use?
A: German parts for your German car.
